quest.title: Speech and Etiquette
quest.description: You successfully locate Eula, who agrees to teach you the customs of the Lawrence Clan. To fulfill the task given to you by Master Jean, it seems you will need to undergo quite the rigorous training program...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x625, Mora x38100, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

chapter.title: The Spindrift Shall Never Return to the Sea

talks.objective: Go to the plaza in front of the Cathedral

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Ah, you've finally arrived. There's no time to spare, so we'll begin with our first lesson...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, hold on! There's something we need to clear up first, otherwise it'll keep bugging us!

choices.text: About all that "vengeance" stuff...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: *sigh* So that's still on your mind, huh? Maybe you're the ones who can't let things go.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Don't worry, there's a time and place for exacting vengeance. Besides, I'm not in the mood for any right now, best save it for later.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... you need to be in the right "mood" for vengeance?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I already have a long list of vengeance to exact. Even if I wanted to begin now, I'd have to start in the right order.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Who knows how long it will be before I get to you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, well... if you have so much to take care of, wouldn't it just be easier to give us a clean slate?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Absolutely not! Stealing my targets, calling me a "ruthless ruler," and suspecting my uncle... all worthy of vengeance in my eyes!

choices.text: She's definitely counting...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: But you needn't worry, at least, not whilst we're investigating this matter. I'm sure you're familiar with the phrase: "A man of moral integrity fears no slanderous attack."

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: If Uncle Schubert didn't commit any wrongdoing, then any such investigation will prove fruitless.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: But if he did commit a wrongful act, then he should bear the full punishment.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I'm sure you understand.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I think I'm starting to see what you mean.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Good. Now, there are two key points that aristocrats attach great importance to — your manner of speech, and your bearing.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Let's begin with your manner of speech. Aristocrats have a very unique way of carrying conversation, even with mundane daily topics.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Paimon's already learned some unique conversation!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Mark my words, vengeance will be mine!"

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Not even close. And besides, it sounds strange.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Paimon learned it from you! And didn't you say not to call others "strange"!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It seems you don't respect the rules of your own clan!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: No, I've no need to trouble myself with such frivolous formalities. Here, allow me to demonstrate.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: For example, when greeting a friend, you could say: "As the morning dew greets the coming dawn, so do I greet you, my dear friend."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... As the morning dew does what now?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: However, such a phrase may only be used during the morning hours. Also, the party with whom you're speaking must be of approximately the same status as you.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Morning dew is not uncommon, so it expresses that friendship should not be measured by value, yet also suggests that friendship between aristocrats is pure like water.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Seems like a lot of work just to greet a good friend.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: No no no, you must be prudent with your words. Calling someone a "good friend" could easily offend them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... But didn't you just say my "dear friend" in your example? Paimon's confused...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Yes, I did. But you must know, in the Lawrence family, "dear friend" is a set phrase that can only be used towards certain friends with whom one is acquainted, but not particularly close.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: It sounds much more pleasant to call an acquaintance a "dear friend." So another thing to remember — aristocrats are concerned with face and being polite.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: However, if you were to use "dear friend" to address an intimate friend, the recipient would think that you were deliberately trying to estrange them.

choices.text: This is getting complicated!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: This is only the first step in making a greeting. After addressing one another, you then exchange courtesies.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, wait! This is all too abstract...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... Perhaps it would be better if you... gave some real-life demonstrations.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Ah...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Very well. Come with me, we'll choose some bystanders to converse with.

choices.text: You mean you always have to talk this way!?
She wasn't kidding.
You won't really take revenge, will you?

talks.objective: Talk to Eula
Talk to the locals and observe Eula's demonstration

dialogues.speaker: Norman
dialogues.text: Oh... you're Eula of the Lawrence Clan, right? This can't be good...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Ahem! You there, lowly laborer. You stand in the presence of a member of the illustrious Lawrence Clan. I have words for you.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Please acknowledge the glory bestowed upon thee by the nobility, uhh... what comes next...? Oh, right! By solemnly kneeling to the ground with utmost sincerity.

dialogues.speaker: Norman
dialogues.text: Huh? I can't make heads or tails of anything you're saying!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: *sigh* Hold on, what did they always teach me...?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: "Whenever a dispute arises, protection of your family's prestige and dignity always takes precedence."

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Got it. Ahem! As a lowly commoner, you shall maintain absolute reverence when speaking with those under which you so graciously toil. How dare you speak in such a manner?

dialogues.speaker: Norman
dialogues.text: Ugh, is everyone from the Lawrence Clan so strange?

dialogues.speaker: Norman
dialogues.text: The days of the Lawrence Clan's tyranny have long passed. I don't care what you're trying to do, just beat it.

choices.text: I think you misunderstood her...

response.speaker: Norman
response.text: Like I said, I don't care what you're doing. I have nothing to say to any member of the Lawrence Clan.

response.speaker: Norman
response.text: And here's a word of advice... I wouldn't be caught dead walking too closely with any one of their like in Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Norman
response.text: If that's all, I'll be going. I'm afraid I won't be able to control myself if we talk any longer.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Hey — hey! Don't leave! Halt! Ugh, mark my words, vengeance will be mine!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow... the Lawrence name really does carry a terrible reputation.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Never mind him, I could have predicted as much. Let's find someone else.

choices.text: She's just giving us a demonstration, that's all.

talks.objective: Continue talking to the locals

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Ahem! You there, lowly toiler. You stand in the presence of a member of the illustrious Lawrence Clan. I have words for you.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Please acknowledge the glory bestowed upon thee by the nobility, and solemnly kneel to the ground with utmost sincerity.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Huh? Why don't you respond? According to the custom, I must wait until you kneel completely before I can say the next words.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Ah, right! I mustn't look at you too long, or I'll be drawing more attention to our difference in status... Oh dear, I've already stared at you for quite a while.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Fine, you may spare yourself the formality of kneeling, as it may be a little inconvenient. I shall continue... Oh, wait, I think there's a line for people with rude attitudes in this situation...

dialogues.speaker: Leno
dialogues.text: Hey! Stop bothering me, or else I might say something you wouldn't like to hear!

dialogues.speaker: Leno
dialogues.text: Then again, I've got no words for anyone from the Lawrence Clan.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Again? What's with this attitude?

choices.text: That escalated fast.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Yes, I don't think his attitude will change. If I keep grandstanding like this, the outcome won't be good. Let's try to find someone else to talk to.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Hmph! I'll remember your unwillingness to comply! Mark my words, vengeance will be mine!

choices.text: Maybe we should just stop for now.

talks.objective: Continue talking to the locals

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: You there, lowly worker, I—

dialogues.speaker: Randall
dialogues.text: Yeah, I've already heard it all before. Look, just spare me the time, our answer is always the same. We've got nothing to say to the likes of you.

dialogues.speaker: Randall
dialogues.text: I mean, seriously, can't you just take a hint?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Please calm down, we don't want to cause any trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Randall
dialogues.text: *sigh* I know she's a Knight of Favonius, and that the Knights wouldn't misplace their trust, but the name Lawrence carries too much weight with it.

dialogues.speaker: Randall
dialogues.text: Even to this very day, the descendants of the Lawrence Clan are still scheming to reclaim Mondstadt and reinstate their aristocratic rule.

dialogues.speaker: Randall
dialogues.text: And if that wasn't enough, here you are purposefully using their awkward way of speaking just to put on an act? Don't you care for the feelings of us ordinary folk?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: You have a point.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: But mark my words, this transgression will not go unnoticed!

dialogues.speaker: Randall
dialogues.text: H—Huh? You wanna fight? Listen here, I might be no match for you, but I'll be sure to lodge a complaint with the Knights of Favonius!

choices.text: Maybe we should just call it a day now.

response.speaker: Randall
response.text: I'm sorry but... I want her to understand that I'm serious!

response.speaker: Randall
response.text: Listen here, if you don't want things to get more unpleasant, then you'd better just stop.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Forget it, there's no point in quarreling any further. Let's go.

response.speaker: Randall
response.text: *sigh*...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: It's alright, this happens quite often. Let's find someone else to talk to.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, Paimon thinks we've seen enough now. Let's just stop.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Actually, Paimon thinks we should apologize for asking you to demonstrate for us. We had no idea the feelings between the Lawrence Clan and the people of Mondstadt were so bitter.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Haha, what can we do? The Lawrence name is already a dirty word among every household in Mondstadt. Even three-year-olds know the story. I see this kind of attitude all the time.

choices.text: And somehow you still manage to brush it off with a laugh?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Don't worry, what with me being a Knight of Favonius, they're usually willing to speak a few words with me.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Perhaps my aristocratic manner of speech provoked them today. Believe me, it's not a big issue.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So this is the way things are normally for you? There's no need for them to direct their anger at you personally.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: That's the way things are. Perhaps it's just fate for those who've made mistakes. Accepting punishment is only fair, right? But when your family has committed atrocities, I'm afraid there's no easy path to reconciliation.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: As memories are carried in the city breeze, the faults of such grievances are passed on from one generation to the next. It is now my turn to bear this burden.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: At least I have a means of living a relatively normal life compared to the elders of my family. I have nothing to be discontented about.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So you knew all along that we'd encounter these kinds of problems?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, why were you so willing to try and demonstrate for us?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Oh, that reminds me... that last person will not escape my vengeance either...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: *sigh* Let's leave it at that. Just think of it as something I like to do.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: But unfortunately, you probably didn't learn much from those conversations. It seems we have no other choice but to find more people to talk to.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, n—no need! Besides, the Traveler's pretty sharp, and nothing gets in our way on an adventure. Paimon thinks we've got the gist of it now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right? RIGHT!?

choices.text: Uh... Yeah, I think I've got it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll just have to roll with it for now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's just keep Eula from getting anyone else riled up.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Well then, I'm glad you learned something. You're already halfway toward mastering aristocratic conduct.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: A proper manner of speech is more aesthetic than anything else — it stems from their taste for refinement.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: But we must also practice your bearing.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I have a very effective way of training for this. Come with me to Dragonspine.

choices.text: I'm still not too sure I can do this.
I'm starting to sympathize with you.
Maybe everyone should just take a step back.

talks.objective: Go to Dragonspine for aristocratic conduct training

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Not bad. A lot better than I had anticipated, at least.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *panting* Paimon almost didn't make it through! Whew, good thing we didn't get stuck.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um... so... are we "aristocrats" now?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Don't flatter yourselves. We've only just begun.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: This scenario was relatively simple. In the face of a real battle, one would seldom have a chance to stop and evaluate the situation.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: There's a Ley Line Monolith just up ahead that will attract nearby monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: True elegance is the ability to calmly yet swiftly make decisions in the heat of battle.

choices.text: Is this how you normally train?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: My family set only the highest expectations for me, even as a child.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Let's proceed, shall we?

choices.text: No wonder you are so skilled...

talks.objective: Talk to Eula to learn how the training will proceed

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's s—so c—cold... Does aristocrat training really need to be done here?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: If you wish to truly achieve the dignified conduct of an aristocrat, you must learn to remain composed and elegant even amidst harsh conditions.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: For example, you can see that part of the path up ahead is quite difficult to traverse.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: But a well-trained aristocrat would not only effortlessly proceed forward, but do so without a stain on their garment and their elegance fully intact.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon thinks we've left the realm of aristocrats and entered the realm of adventuring.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Compared to what we've already seen, {NICKNAME}, this should be a piece of cake.

choices.text: Yeah, I'm used to this kind of challenge.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-huh, this is where you can finally apply some of your adventuring knowledge.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Haha, you look pretty confident this time.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Alright, let's get started. Remember, you must be graceful and elegant. Don't get knocked or launched into the air, that would be most unsightly.

choices.text: Should be way easier than making conversation, at least.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks so too... But you've got this in the bag!

talks.objective: Reach the objective without being launched or taking any damage
Reach the objective without being launched or taking any damage
Reach the destination without being launched or taking any damage
Talk to Eula

dialogues.speaker: Randall
dialogues.text: So it seems you've finally given up on the idea of finding more people to talk to.

dialogues.speaker: Randall
dialogues.text: Believe me, that's in everyone's best interest.

talks.objective: Go to the training location and activate the Ley Line Monolith

dialogues.speaker: Leno
dialogues.text: Listen, I have no idea what she's trying to do... But trust me, you two should just keep away from her.

talks.objective: Defeat the opponents without being launched or Frozen

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: It'll be difficult at first, but the key is to remain patient. Let's try again.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Remember, you must be elegant... Don't get knocked or launched into the air.

talks.objective: Talk to Eula

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Well done. Your performance was most impressive.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: And you managed to remain calm even in these grueling Dragonspine surroundings, haha. I'm starting to wonder if even I could have done the same.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Given such an outstanding performance, it seems there is little left for me to teach you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Like Paimon said, adventuring is our specialty!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe... So that's it for our training, right? Then let's get out of Dragonspine before Paimon turns into a popsicle! *shivers*

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: #Hold on. I was commending {NICKNAME}'s performance just now. You, on the other hand, seem to have made no progress at all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? You mean, Paimon was also part of the training!?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Yes, of course. You were frantically flying and dashing about throughout the entire thing. Not an elegant sight at all.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Did you even listen to anything I was trying to teach you?

choices.text: Maybe the weather is just too cold here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, that's it, it's too cold here. B—Besides, Paimon was paying attention to the Traveler.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Whatever the reason, not heeding my instructions... a cause for vengeance, perhaps...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: *sigh* Now, drink this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? What is it? *gasp* Are you trying to poison Paimon!?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Certainly not. It's warm milk.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Didn't you just say that you were freezing? Drink it and it'll help warm you up.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh... uh... thank you! Um, are you... still planning on the whole vengeance thing?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: If I wasn't, then why would I care about you being cold? If you turned into a Paimon popsicle, that would ruin my plans for vengeance now, wouldn't it...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: So, "dear friend"... don't die on me out here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahh! Paimon knew something was off!

choices.text: Thank you for looking after Paimon.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: All in the name of vengeance, no need to thank me.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Now then, given that your training is complete, it's time we return to Mondstadt. Our last step will be preparing a cordial gift to present to my uncle when you meet him.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I already have something in mind. Let's pay Sara a visit at Good Hunter.

choices.text: You're... strange.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Hehe, vengeance should know no bounds, you know...

choices.text: Maybe that's just Paimon's style?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, that's not true! Paimon was just focusing on you the whole time!

talks.objective: Go to Good Hunter to get a greeting gift
Talk to Eula and Amber

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Oh, hey Eula! I see you've met the Honorary Knight!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We meet again, Amber! Seems we're just bound to run into you these days.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Well, I just got back and was thinking about grabbing a bite at Good Hunter. But now that you're here, why don't we all eat together?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Very well. It's been some time since we've last shared a meal together.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Come, take a seat. We can discuss my uncle's gift while we eat.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Yes, is there something else you'd like to order?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Could you please prepare a serving of my uncle's favorite, Gebratenes Fleisch mit Sauerkraut? We'll take it as a gift to him later.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Coming right up! It'll take some time to prepare, I'll have it here at the counter once it's ready.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Hold on a moment. Is this Satisfying Salad also something that Amber ordered?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: No, she didn't order it. But because she didn't order any vegetables, I thought I'd throw in a salad on the house. You know, to contrast all the meat dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: So... we clearly didn't order this, yet you prepared it without authorization... Hmph! Mark my words, this transgression will not go unnoticed!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... you're going to take revenge on her for giving us a free salad!?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Hmph, you should know me by now, that's the kind of villainous character I am!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Well then... please wait a moment while I get the dish for your uncle started.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Hmph, delicious unauthorized delicacies... Sara will pay for this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why would you choose Gebratenes Fleisch mit Sauerkraut as a gift for your uncle? Paimon's never even heard of that dish before...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: This dish isn't actually on Good Hunter's menu. Only longstanding patrons such as my uncle would know about the dish. The old aristocrats seem to take a liking to it.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Because of the sour flavor of the sauerkraut, not too many people are fond of it these days. I guess it's become less popular over time.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Eula treated me to the dish once, and I couldn't even finish a bite. I've nicknamed it "Gebratenes Fleisch mit Vengeance" ever since. Yuck!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: I never expected us to have such completely different tastes in food... If I weren't in such a good mood, I'd say that constitutes grounds for transgression...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh, so even Amber doesn't escape your vengeance?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Of course not! It's hard to find someone in Mondstadt that attracts contempt as much as she does.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Haha, it's fine when you're just joking between us, but I'm afraid our Honorary Knight might misunderstand you.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Eula's always talking about vengeance, but that's just how she is. It's nothing you should take too seriously.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: But I am serious! And I'll remember every transgression committed against me! Ugh, it's no wonder so many people dislike you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's starting to realize that Eula is actually a very good person.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's no need to be so awkward when you want to say something nice.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: *sigh* Listen, you've never been labeled as a social pariah, have you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What... well... no...?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: So that's why you wouldn't understand how hard it is for a bad person to try to be good. It's impossible for me, and I have no intention of acting like a good person.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Alright, no need to look so sullen... I'm just kidding. Come on, let's eat. The food is getting cold.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Ooh, I'm stuffed. I'll see Sara about the bill.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: No need, I've left the Mora under the plate. If you try to settle it with her in person, she won't accept payment for the salad.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Don't underestimate my ability to exact revenge. Hah! Sara won't get the upper hand this time!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Alright, next you should pay my uncle a visit. He has a small camp at the top of the mountain near Springvale. He usually whiles his time away there when there's nothing else to do.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Aren't you coming with us, Eula?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: I'm afraid that wouldn't be very convenient for me. It'd be better if you two went alone.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Ah yes, please do remember to pick up the dish from Sara.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: I still have more recon to do in the wilderness. Well, until next time!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Let's meet again. What an interesting bunch you are.

talks.objective: Get a Gebratenes Fleisch mit Sauerkraut from Sara

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Here, the Gebratenes Fleisch mit Sauerkraut is ready to go! Be sure to eat it while it's hot, otherwise the flavor will be spoiled.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: And by the way, don't worry too much when Eula says strange things. She's actually a very good person.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's been meaning to ask... No one could stand the sight of Eula when she was trying to speak with the others in Mondstadt earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But she seemed to get along fine with you and Amber just now... what's up with that?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: The people of Mondstadt don't take kindly to anyone bearing the Lawrence name.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: They are unable to see past her family, therefore they don't actually see Eula for herself.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: So no matter what Eula tries to do, it's seen as a wrongdoing. It essentially strips the meaning of anything she tries to accomplish.

choices.text: I think I understand now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How come you're able to see Eula differently then?

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: Well, when she joined the Knights of Favonius, it caused quite an uproar.

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: Many people signed a petition, demanding that the Knights reverse their decision.

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: At the same time, numerous members of the Lawrence Clan crowded the entrance of the Knights of Favonius Headquarters, clamoring for Eula to give an explanation.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa... so both sides were unhappy.

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: That's right. So, you can imagine how determined Eula must have been under such circumstances.

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: But thanks to Grand Master Varka and the unwavering attitudes of others in the Knights of Favonius, they were able to quell the unrest. Tensions still remain beneath the surface, I'm afraid.

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: In the eyes of the people, she's a stain on the Knights of Favonius... and in the eyes of the Lawrence Clan, she's a disgrace to her family.

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: But she simply fulfills her duty as a Knight, silently helping one person after another, myself included.

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: People like Eula should be approached with care and understanding. She could stand to be treated a little more fairly.

choices.text: It's good that you're able to understand her.

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: I believe a day will come when things will get better.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Once everything's settled, we should go talk to Eula again. Paimon thinks we know how to communicate with her now.

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: I'm glad. I think that would make her very happy, though she might not ever admit it.

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: Take care. Please come again!

choices.text: If only there were more people like you.
So that's what she meant when she said it was hard for "a bad person to try to be good."

dialogues.text: Uh... Paimon's confused... This girl's all "vengeance this" and "revenge that," but she doesn't seem the least bit angry...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, Paimon has met bigger weirdos before...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
